This is an error stop with transient agent-start at Code-Burler-Review. Five launches over two attempts all failed the same way: the provider came up, loaded its skills and drew an idle, empty input box. The shuttle readiness check still reported "no input box is on screen".
I checked the cause in the code. internal/shuttleengine/claudeengine/session.go isTopBoxRule (around line 342) accepts only three top-rule shapes:
- a line starting with three rule glyphs and ending with one
- a line ending in the cut-label marker "… ─"
- a plain rule
The captured top rule is "─ ly:intake-checks-already-fixed:code-burler-review ─": one glyph, then the label on the left, then one glyph. It matches none of those shapes, so inputBoxInterior finds no top rule and judgeReadiness reports no input box.
The label is built from the run and role names, so every new strand draws the same rule. A plain re-launch or a goto would fail the same way. main has no newer change to session.go (its last change there is e6b40df6a, which this branch already holds).
The fix belongs in the shuttle's box detector, which is outside this task's scope. The task only changes the intake role rules (and possibly lym board intake close), so the edit rules give me no fix of my own here. Neither the board entry nor the decision record settles the detector change. I ran no verbs and made no commit.
